name: Saruwatari
source:
Pikari Cleaning personnel.
Although his day job is a comedian, most of his income comes from the salary he gets from working at "Pikari Cleaning".
Saruwatari is the owner of a friendly and caring personality. Also, he is the employee who is the most trusted by the President of Pikari Claning.
As a comedian is not yet blossomed, therefore he is concerned about his future.

The thing he treasures the most: Charles Chaplin DVD-BOX
His Wish: To have a photogravure idol (model) girlfriend

[Roughly translated from [url=http://risusoftnosferatu.blog49.fc2.com/blog-entry-4.html]the official website[/url]]
